metadata.description: CLI tools skills for Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI

plugins.name: grok-search
plugins.description: Enhanced web search and real-time content retrieval via Grok API

plugins.name: sequential-think
plugins.description: Multi-step reasoning engine for complex analysis and systematic problem solving

plugins.name: exa
plugins.description: High-precision semantic search via Exa API

plugins.name: time
plugins.description: Time and timezone utilities for getting current time and converting between timezones

plugins.name: serena
plugins.description: Semantic code understanding with IDE-like symbol operations

plugins.name: ace-tool
plugins.description: Semantic codebase search and prompt enhancement

plugins.name: agent-wiki
plugins.description: Incremental LLM-friendly wiki generator for Obsidian note vaults

plugins.name: capability-evolver
plugins.description: Self-evolution engine for AI agents; protocol-constrained evolution via EvoMap A2A and a local Proxy mailbox

plugins.name: cc-agy
plugins.description: Delegate coding/research tasks to the Google Antigravity CLI (agy) for external-model execution; replaces collaborating-with-gemini

plugins.name: github-trending-analyzer
plugins.description: Crawl GitHub trending repositories, analyze with LLM for Chinese insights, categorize by themes, compute diffs against history, and generate Markdown reports; default brief mode or opt-in detailed per-project analysis, with caching

plugins.name: context7
plugins.description: Fetch up-to-date library/framework/API documentation from Context7, bypassing training-cutoff limits; two-skill split (main + forked fetcher) minimizes token use on API calls

plugins.name: cc-codex
plugins.description: Delegate coding tasks to Codex CLI for prototyping, debugging, and code review; multi-turn sessions via SESSION_ID, sandbox=read-only by default, unified diff patches only

plugins.name: codex-cc
plugins.description: Delegate coding tasks from Codex to local Claude Code; preserves trusted Claude runtime customizations by default and supports SESSION_ID resume plus mcp/plugin passthrough

plugins.name: grill-me
plugins.description: Grill the user about a requirement, decision, or idea before implementation, then produce an actionable planning report without writing code

plugins.name: literature-searcher
plugins.description: Search CrossRef, OpenAlex, PubMed, Semantic Scholar, and optional Scopus; deduplicate results, download open-access PDFs by DOI, classify papers, monitor new results, and analyze coverage
